from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class HousingStartEntry(BaseModel):
    """A single data point extracted from a housing starts report (Table 3a)."""
    data_month: str = Field(description="The month the data refers to, in YYYY-MM format")
    region: str = Field(description="The region the data refers to (e.g., 'South', 'Northeast', 'Midwest', 'West', 'United States Total')")
    saar_value: float = Field(description="The Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate for housing starts")
    report_release_date: str = Field(description="The date this specific report was released, in YYYY-MM-DD format, used to resolve precedence")
    data_status: str | None = Field(description="Status of the data in this report, e.g., 'p' for preliminary, 'r' for revised")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    housing_start_entries: list[HousingStartEntry]
